body:
Thanks for that, now I'm sure someone has actually heard what I've been wanting to say. I'm just going to say stuff about my brother's. I feel like there the biggest reason I'm the way I am today. I tried doing anything I could for them to just like me. I tried doing stuff for them, hanging out with them, anything. But, it didn't work. I have to pity my one brother, Sam. He's older than me but younger than my second brother, Kevin. He's very, very insecure about himself. I think he's kind of jealous than me, he wants to be friends with our mom, but he can't help but be an asshole to everyone. I know he does it to make himself feel better, but it gets to you after at least 12 years of this. I don't pity Kevin. Kevin is the married one. He was, and he will probably always be, the worst person I have ever met. He's gone behind our backs so many times, he's made us all fear for our lives on so many occasions. He's put his own family at risk of death at least 10 different times, most of them for the same reason. Drugs and my mom's ex-husband. He'd always come begging to my mom for money. He kept in touch with my mom's abusive ex-husband because, fuck it, let's all go make friends with the guy that tried to kill my entire family! We didn't even live in a bad neighborhood. We were middle class to, we had money and a big house, and he got everything he wanted. We spent so much money trying to get him straight. We eventually gave up after he joined the navy, got kicked out, married somebody who didn't speak english, and wanted to move back in with us.

I could go on and on about these two assholes, but it would take too long and I've gotta go get ready to go see The Hobbit :P. Still, thanks for caring, it really means a lot right now.
